lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah that Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is coming to strike Egypt, and the news is to be proclaimed in Migdol.
The LORD has thrust Egypt's warriors down, and there they will cry out that Pharaoh was all noise.
The daughter in Egypt must pack for exile, and a lion from the north is coming against Egypt.
The LORD will punish Amon god of Zoan and Pharaoh, delivering them to Nebuchadnezzar, but Egypt will be inhabited again.
